authority: Current application source and DESIGN.md; verification evidence is recorded in DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md
capture_unit: macOS logical window points; record screenshot pixel size and backing scale separately
baseline_status: Current-source evidence may be captured; human approval must be recorded separately. Never overwrite an earlier run.

cases.steps: Open the home view and capture the entire window.
cases.check: Preserve the yellow leaf-m brand, current home hierarchy, and input area; controls remain visible at the minimum quick-window size.

cases.steps: Search the library for the desktop term from the referenced fixture, then open its current-direction memory.
cases.check: Keep the compact list and wide reading pane; distinguish current content, original input, and versions; current content never overwrites original input.

cases.steps: Expand original input and version history; inspect old and current versions.
cases.check: Changing versions does not mutate source text; citations match the actual version; long text does not obscure controls.

cases.steps: Open the memory More menu, then close it.
cases.check: Single-memory export stays in the collapsed More menu.

cases.steps: Open the fixed discussion from the referenced fixture and expand its citations.
cases.check: Questions, sources, and follow-up discussion share the existing styles; current and historical sources are labeled accurately.

cases.steps: In an isolated synthetic library, generate an answer, manually save selected text to an existing memory, edit and cancel; reopen, confirm, then undo.
cases.check: Nothing is saved before confirmation; append by default; review the complete text before an integrated rewrite; undo preserves confirmed original input. Requires a local fixed endpoint or an explicitly selected test model.

cases.steps: Use a Chinese IME; select a composition candidate with Enter, insert a newline, submit with Command+Enter, then click another page after editing.
cases.check: Composition does not submit accidentally; physical clicks work; input focus remains stable.

cases.steps: Open with the physical global shortcut; save and collapse; pin and save again; drag and hide the leaf; return to the main window.
cases.check: Preserve drafts; pinned capture remains ready; dragging does not trigger clicks; handoff keeps the discussion.

cases.steps: Collapse and reopen while an answer is running; stop another answer and wait for its response; quit during generation and restart.
cases.check: Collapsed work continues without reopening on completion; late responses after cancellation have no effect; restart exposes interruption and retry.

cases.steps: In a synthetic library, open a change comparison and type a Chinese draft; explicitly capture test text using the MCP executable from the same app bundle.
cases.check: Refresh displays the new content while preserving the change comparison and active draft.
